title: Mortal Kombat – Now Streaming Trailer Out
excerpt: Official trailer for Mortal Kombat – Now Streaming.
body:
• The trailer for Mortal Kombat – Now Streaming dropped October 12, 2026.
  • A fight for the fate of all, the ultimate battle begins.

The makers of Mortal Kombat – Now Streaming have released the official trailer, unveiled October 12, 2026.

A fight for the fate of all, the ultimate battle begins.

For diaspora audiences tracking the film's US release, the trailer is the first real look at what's headed to streaming.
